# BHD Asia

> BHD Asia (Business & Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd) is a boutique executive coaching, HR consulting and TRE® (Tension & Trauma Releasing Exercises) practice based in Singapore, working with leaders and organisations globally. Founded in 2012 and led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira — ICF-certified executive coach and Global TRE® Certifying Trainer with 30+ years of corporate HR experience and 1,800+ coaching hours. Coaching is offered in English, French and Spanish.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://bhdasia.com/services.html): Executive coaching, HR consulting, leadership development, resilience building and TRE® workshops for organisations. Corporate coaching engagements from SGD 6,000 for 8 sessions.
- [Contact / book a discovery call](https://bhdasia.com/contact.html): All engagements start with a free discovery conversation.

## Team

- [About BHD Asia](https://bhdasia.com/about.html): Company story, mission and the four-person coaching team.
- [Isabelle Claus Teixeira](https://bhdasia.com/isabelle.html): Founder — ICF-certified executive coach, Global TRE® Certifying Trainer, 30+ years in HR and human development.
- [Dr. Jasmine Low](https://bhdasia.com/jasmine.html): Organisational psychologist and ORSC systems coach.
- [Simba Stenqvist](https://bhdasia.com/simba.html): Somatic practitioner and TRE® specialist, trained in close collaboration with TRE® founder Dr. David Berceli.
- [Rina Ho](https://bhdasia.com/rina.html): Executive coach and TRE® practitioner; 25+ years at Sony, Reebok and adidas.
